_about: Sulfolane (1) + Water (2): isothermal total pressures at 413.18 K. Rows: temperature in K, liquid mole fraction of sulfolane, pressure in kPa, as stored in the ThermoML Archive record. Rows with x_1 = 0 and 1 are the pure-component pressures measured with the same set.

source.citation: S. Horstmann, K. Fischer, J. Gmehling, Isothermal Vapor-Liquid Equilibrium and Excess Enthalpy Data for the Binary Systems Water + Sulfolane and Methanol + N-Methyl-2-pyrrolidone (NMP), J. Chem. Eng. Data 49 (2004) 1499-1503
source.access: The journal article may be subscription-only; the same data is public in the NIST TRC ThermoML Archive (NIST open license).
source.tables: ThermoML record, PureOrMixtureData 2. The table number in the article was not checked.
